title: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.04871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving an industrial recommender is an iterative research-and-engineering process rather than a direct path from idea to deployment. In \textbf{DASHEN, NetEase's gaming-community app}, algorithm engineers typically identify promising directions from research papers, technical reports, and prior production experiments; reproduce or adapt the underlying methods; implement them in the production codebase; and evaluate the resulting models through training and offline experiments. Promising candidates are then advanced to online A/B tests, and those demonstrating robust gains are submitted to Launch Review---the internal gate for full-traffic rollout. Large language models (LLMs) can assist with individual stages of this workflow, but the overall process remains human-dependent without a harness that can reliably coordinate them across long-running, often multi-day experimental cycles. translated_title: AutoLR：在工业推荐系统中实现从研究到上线评审路径的自动化
translated_abstract: 改进工业推荐系统是一个研究性与工程性交织的迭代过程，而非从想法到部署的直接路径。在网易游戏社区应用DASHEN中，算法工程师通常从研究论文、技术报告和以往的生产实验中识别有前景的方向；复现或改编其中的底层方法；将其实现在生产代码库中；并通过训练和离线实验评估所得模型。有前景的候选方案随后进入在线A/B测试，那些展现出稳健收益的方案将被提交至上线评审（Launch Review）——这是全流量发布前的内部审核关口。大语言模型（LLM）虽然可以协助该工作流程中的单个环节，但在缺乏一个能够在长期运行、往往持续数天的实验周期中可靠协调各环节的框架的情况下，整个流程仍然依赖人工。我们提出了AutoLR，其最初构建为……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AutoLR框架，利用大语言模型自动协调工业推荐系统中从研究方法复现、生产实现、离线评估到在线A/B测试和上线评审的完整实验流程，摆脱了对人工的多日实验周期依赖。
en_tdlr: AutoLR is an automation framework that leverages large language models to orchestrate the full pipeline of industrial recommender improvement—from reproducing research methods, implementing them in production, running offline evaluations, to A/B testing and launch review—reducing human dependency in multi-day experimental cycles.
